entities.summary: Patrick Joseph Kelly was an Irish Roman Catholic missionary and bishop who served as the Bishop of Benin City, Nigeria, from 1950 to 1973. A member of the Society of African Missions (SMA), he played a pivotal role in the expansion of the Catholic Church in Nigeria, particularly in the areas of education, healthcare, and pastoral care.
